name: ship-issue-2
description: Ship one GitHub issue or adhoc task to a finished PR — tiered planning, one fresh Codex session per chunk, a usage ledger per run.

interface.shortDescription: Take one issue to a finished PR with Codex.
interface.longDescription: Confirm acceptance criteria and a planning tier, resolve questions visually, plan in token-sized chunks (proposing an issue split past two chunks), implement each chunk in a fresh Codex session, run tests, open a PR, and run one Codex review round — logging every session's token usage to a ledger. The human approves the plan and makes the merge.
defaultPrompt: Ship this: add dark mode to the settings page
